title: [For Hire] founder-led marketing for AI founders, $500/mo, because your face converts better than your logo
description:
quick truth: theres a hundred tools that all sound the same, same buzzwords, same "revolutionary" claims, same brand voice that says nothing. people are tired of it. what actually cuts through is a founder who sounds like a human, who has opinions, who shows the messy real stuff behind the product, not another polished company account nobody remembers

thats founder-led marketing and its probably the highest leverage thing youre not doing right now. not because you dont believe in it, most founders do, but because you dont have the time and hiring a full marketing setup for it doesnt make sense at your stage yet

so heres the gap im filling: i turn founders into their own best marketing asset for $500+taxes a month. no bloated retainer, no agency overhead, no juggling 3 freelancers for content, design and engagement separately

what that actually looks like:

  • 3 posts a week written in your voice, not brand-speak or AI stuff
  • design handled whenever a post needs it, not billed separately
  • comments and dms handled on your behalf so youre not stuck replying at midnight
  • consistent enough that people start recognizing you, not just your product

the founders who win the "who do i trust" game in a crowded AI market are the ones who showed up consistently before they needed to. this is how you start that without it eating your week

if this is something you've been meaning to do but keep pushing down the list, comment or dm and lets talk
